whyItMatters: A hardcoded password in version control is readable by everyone with repository access and by every future holder of a clone or export, until it is rotated.
actions: Rotate the password immediately and audit what it accessed.
Move the secret to environment variables or a secret manager loaded at runtime.
Rewrite repository history only if policy requires it; rotation is the fix that matters.
verification: The password is rotated and no live hardcoded password remains in the repository.
